Title

LIN-V8K（エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ）

Card Text

地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。

Lore

代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このＬＩＮ－Ｖ８Ｋはジャワに再改造されたもの。

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay). '''English reading aid (AI translation)''' '''Lore:''' A typical armored droid for laying mines and demolition, adapted for military use. It lays and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K has been modified again by Jawas. '''Game text:''' Can lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to ‘disable’ (lose) one mine at the same location card.

Title

ポップス

Card Text

彼が操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。ゴールド５を操縦している場合、さらに回避値に＋１し、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、１回だけ引くことができる。

Lore

ヤヴィンの戦いにおけるゴールド５のパイロット。本名はデイヴィッシュ・クレイル。飛行歴20年のベテランで、ゴールドリーダーの編隊で片翼を担う。

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Pops. '''English reading aid (AI translation)''' '''Lore:''' Pilot of [[Gold 5]] at the Battle of Yavin. His real name is Davish Krail. A veteran with 20 years of flying experience, he flies on one wing of [[Dutch|Gold Leader]]’s formation. '''Game text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting [[Gold 5]], also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to draw battle destiny.

rows.text:
__NOTOC__

[[File:Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-Kenobi-7cf786442c8d.jpeg|280px]]

'''Virtual Modern Errata''' — [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi (V) (Errata)]] (207_12) — current
Destiny3[[:File:Japanese-Help-Me-Obi-Wan-Kenobi-7cf786442c8d.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]].
'''Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

助けて下さい、オビ＝ワン・ケノービ

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配する位置にオビ＝ワンがいる時に使う。このターンの間、オビ＝ワンの能力値を好きなだけ減らし、減らした分を、任意のロケーションでの戦闘の合計能力値に足せる。2：戦闘が起こった際、隣接した位置に反乱軍がいれば、1名選んで、リアクションとして戦闘が始まった位置に移動できる。

Lore

''レイアは要請をホログラムに託した。「ケノービ将軍、かつてクローン大戦の際、あなたは我が父に仕えてくださいました。帝国軍と戦うため、再びあなたの力が必要なのです。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Lore:''' Leia entrusted her request to a hologram. ‘General Kenobi, during the Clone Wars you served my father. To fight the Imperial forces, your help is needed again.’ '''Game text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Obi-Wan is at a location you control. For this turn, you may reduce Obi-Wan's ability by any amount and add the amount reduced to the total ability in battle at any location. 2: When a battle occurs, if a Rebel is at an adjacent location, choose one and move that person as a reaction to the location where the battle began. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore says Leia's father asks Kenobi for help in his struggle; the Japanese says help is needed again to fight the Imperial forces. The English game text refers to a site you control, applying ability toward drawing battle destiny at another location, and ability used this way not being usable again that turn. The Japanese text instead refers to a controlled location, adding the reduction to total ability in battle at any location, and does not state the same restriction. The English second option specifies an adjacent battle site; the Japanese uses location.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p.41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

See Also

* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese publications]]

Title

＊ポンダ・バーバ

Card Text

ドクター・エヴァザンのいる位置カードで戦闘を行う場合、戦闘力を＋３できる。ただし、そこに相手のライトセーバーがない場合に限る。ポンダ・バーバが操縦している宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。

Lore

''クアラ（指のあるアクアリッシュ）の男性。殺し屋にして密輸屋。相棒のドクター・エヴァザンに、性能の悪い人工生体の義手を移植される。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Ponda Baba. '''Card text:''' When battling at a site where [[Dr. Evazan]] is present, you may add 3 to Ponda Baba's power, but only if none of your opponent's lightsabers is there. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. '''Lore:''' A male Quara (a fingered Aqualish), an assassin and smuggler. His partner Dr. Evazan fitted him with a poorly functioning bioprosthetic hand.

Characteristics

* Male * Quara (Aqualish) * Smuggler

Notes

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The later [[Ponda Baba (Errata)|English errata]] says anything he pilots.[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, Ponda Baba entry. Japanese-language printing of [[Ponda Baba]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Sources

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 99 (Japanese Premiere checklist, side, type and rarity). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. * [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0#Landspeed|Decipher Rulebook 2.0, Landspeed]] (base landspeed 1).

Title

オーバーロード

Card Text

任意の武器（ガッフィの杖やイウォークの武器を除く）を１つ対象に選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＜その武器の運命数なら、その武器はロストする。運命数＝０なら、武器を保持しているキャラクターや宇宙船も同時にロストする。

Lore

''ライトセーバー、ターボレーザー、ブラスターといった武器は強力なエネルギーセルやジェネレーターで作動する。時にはセルがオーバーヒートして、武器ごと爆発することもある。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Overload. '''Card text:''' Choose any one weapon except a [[Gaderffii Stick]] or an Ewok weapon as the target. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than that weapon's destiny, the weapon is lost. If destiny is 0, the character or starship carrying the weapon is also lost at the same time.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Overload-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. '''Lore:''' Weapons such as lightsabers, turbolasers and blasters operate using powerful energy cells or generators. Sometimes a cell overheats and explodes together with the weapon.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Overload]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

絞殺

Card Text

次のうちどちらかを選ぶ。１：任意の反乱軍の兵員／トルーパー１名を即座にロストさせる。２：ダーク・ジェダイを参加させた戦闘に勝った直後に使う。１フォース消費して、戦闘に参加した相手のキャラクターを１名選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＞対象の能力値なら、対象はロストする。

Lore

''ダース・ベイダーは、尋問の際、少々物理的な手段を取ることもある。タンティヴィIVのアンティリズ艦長は、デス・スターの設計図のありかを吐くよりも、死を選んだ。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Strangulation. '''Card text:''' Choose one of the following. 1: Immediately cause any one Rebel trooper to be lost. 2: Use immediately after winning a battle in which a [[Dark Jedi]] participated. Use 1 Force and choose one opposing character that participated in the battle. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the target's ability, the target is lost.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Physical-Choke-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. '''Lore:''' Darth Vader sometimes uses somewhat physical methods during interrogation. Captain Antilles of the Tantive IV chose death rather than reveal the whereabouts of the Death Star plans.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Physical Choke]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

正確な射撃

Card Text

いずれかの位置カード上での戦闘において、その場所にある自分の武器を２つ以上同時に用い、武器運命数を合計して単独のキャラクターかビークルを攻撃することができる。

Lore

''「帝国軍のストームトルーパーでなければ、これほど正確には仕留められぬ。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Accurate Shooting. '''Card text:''' During a battle at a site, you may use two or more of your weapons there together and add their weapon destiny values to attack a single character or vehicle.[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Precise-Attack-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. '''Lore:''' “No one but Imperial stormtroopers could make a kill this precisely.”

Notes
